descriptionText:
Paul Skenes 2-card lot, Pittsburgh Pirates.

1) 2024 Topps Update Series #US288 - Paul Skenes ROOKIE CARD (RC logo, Rookie Debut 5/11/2024)
2) 2026 Topps Series 1 Stars of MLB #SMLB-21 - Paul Skenes insert

Skenes was the Pirates' #1 pick in July 2023, made his MLB debut on 5/11/2024, and won the NL Rookie of the Year Award in 2024 with a 1.96 ERA and 0.947 WHIP.

Ungraded, near mint or better. Both cards are pictured front and back. You will receive the exact two cards shown. Shipped in sleeves and a toploader, protected.
